name: Respecting Other Cultures
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to be transformed by renewing their minds rather than conforming to worldly patterns, which includes how we view and interact with others from different cultures (Romans 12:2). In Christ, distinctions such as Jew or Greek are transcended, affirming unity and equality among all believers (Galatians 3:28). This unity calls us to avoid judgment and contempt toward others, recognizing that all will stand before the judgment seat of Christ (Romans 14:10). Our respect for other cultures flows from understanding our shared identity in Christ rather than earthly divisions.
